# Village of Derby Center municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 7; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Title 24 Appendix V.S.A. chapter 215 section 202 (official text, Vermont General Assembly): provides for the election of three Trustees at the village annual meeting on staggered 3-year terms.

Village of Derby Center Annual Report for the year ending February 28, 2025 (derbyvt.org): lists the trustees as Marcel Caron (term expiring April 2025), Rosaire Fortin (April 2026), and Stephen Mengel (April 2027). The village publishes no official record of its April 2025 or April 2026 annual-meeting outcomes, so only Mengel, whose term runs past the most recent meeting, is recorded; the other two seats are left unfilled rather than guessed.
Title 24 Appendix V.S.A. chapter 215 section 202 (official text, Vermont General Assembly): provides for the election of a Village Clerk at the annual meeting.
Village of Derby Center office page (derbyvt.org, current): lists Elizabeth Bumps as the village's Clerk/Treasurer today.

Village of Derby Center Annual Report for the year ending February 28, 2025 (derbyvt.org): the officers page lists Elizabeth Bumps as Clerk, Treasurer, and Tax Collector. The village publishes no roster past February 2025; Bumps is also a Derby town justice of the peace and cemetery commissioner, and this membership attaches to that same person record.
